nodes.label: The Ladder (YAGNI -> reuse -> stdlib -> native -> installed dep -> one line -> minimum)
nodes.rationale: Stop at the first rung that holds: question whether the task needs to exist (YAGNI), reuse what already lives in the codebase, use stdlib, use native platform features, use already-installed dependencies, then one line, then the minimum code that works. The ladder is a reflex that runs after understanding the problem, not instead of it.

nodes.label: ponytail: Comment Convention
nodes.rationale: Mark deliberate simplifications with a `ponytail:` comment (`// ponytail: this exists`) so simple reads as intent, not ignorance; shortcuts with a known ceiling name the ceiling and the upgrade path so a deferral cannot quietly become permanent.
